description: Check one OCPI object, sent as JSON text, against the schema ChargerDojo grades that object with at one OCPI version, and list each field that breaks it. The JSON leaves your machine and is sent to chargerdojo.com; it is not stored or logged. Up to 64 KB, 30 calls a minute. Answers: is this a valid OCPI object at my version.

json.description: The object itself as JSON text, without the response envelope.

object.description: Which OCPI object the JSON is, for example token or session.

name: chargerdojo_validate_payload
title: Validate an OCPI object
